detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation and Computational Creativity Review
detail.summary: Current investigation into computational creativity and autonomous problem formulation continues to rely on the established framework of formulation, representation, manipulation, and evaluation. Integration between these components remains a critical bottleneck for agent autonomy. Due to current constraints, empirical research expansion is paused.
